Functional Description: Returns the minimum value of each row of the input tensor in the given dimension dim, along with the index location of each minimum value found. If keepdim is True, the output tensors retain the same size as input except in the dimension dim where they are of size 1. Otherwise, dim is squeezed, resulting in the output tensors having 1 fewer dimension than input. If there are multiple minimal values in a reduced row, the indices of the first minimal value are returned. The function can also compare two tensors element-wise and return a tensor with the minimum values.
Wrapper Entry Information: min(input, dim, keepdim=False, *, out=None) -> (Tensor, LongTensor) Args: input (Tensor): the input tensor. dim (int): the dimension to reduce. keepdim (bool): whether the output tensor has :attr:`dim` retained or not. Keyword args: out (tuple, optional): the tuple of two output tensors (min, min_indices)
